source: Structured Shopify Admin connector; one bounded read-only query; no browser or event sends.

coverage.query_time_snapshot_atomicity: NOT_GUARANTEED; one returned response; cutoff is order creation, current fields are read-time values.

cohort_definition.server_filter: Quoted created_at bounds only; all statuses retained in memory for exclusion/change detection.
cohort_definition.local_inclusion: displayFinancialStatus == PAID AND test == false AND cancelledAt == null AND sourceName == web

change_since_saved_cutoff.join_basis: Saved evidence intentionally has no order IDs. Matched unique createdAt plus exact public product/variant IDs and ordered quantities in memory; separate money/status/country/current-quantity comparisons. No raw IDs/timestamps persisted here.

product_aggregates.revenue_allocation_basis: Whole current order subtotal; every observed basket contains only this product.

product_aggregates.revenue_allocation_basis: Whole current order subtotal; every observed basket contains only this product.

historical_campaign_candidate_join.reason: No parent-product match to any of the eight historical candidate parents, so none of their19 listed variant units can match. Candidate campaign status/configuration not refreshed.

calculation_basis.money_arithmetic: Decimal strings converted to exact integer cents; no binary floating-point money arithmetic.
calculation_basis.merchandise_basis: currentSubtotalPriceSet.shopMoney; current tax is0 and it equals original subtotal for both orders. Recorded refunds are shown separately and are not subtracted again.
calculation_basis.presentment_currency: Aggregate each currency separately. EUR46.90 is the Belgian basket presentment; USD54.47 is its Shopify shop-currency subtotal. No assumed settled FX conversion.
calculation_basis.paid_label: PAID means Shopify financial status, not paid-media attribution.
calculation_basis.saved_basket_comparison: Current public product title can reflect later title repairs; exact product/variant IDs and quantities identify the catalog selections.

interpretation.paid_growth_sales_since_previous_checkpo: UNKNOWN attribution;0 new qualifying Shopify order creations.
interpretation.new_sales_learning: No additional purchase or revenue signal in this scoped interval; no traffic/click or campaign serving measurement was performed.
interpretation.fulfillment: Both reported UNFULFILLED; this is Shopify admin status, not proof of supplier dispatch or eventual delivery.
interpretation.source_attribution: Prior saved Google visit labels were not refreshed. They did not establish paid versus organic; no new attribution conclusion is made.
interpretation.refund_limit: Recorded refunds0 at read time; future returns, disputes and retained economics are unresolved.
interpretation.fee_cost_limit: Prior scoped payment-fee evidence exists but was not refreshed or converted to settled USD here. Actual provider costs and acquisition expense are not reconciled in this checkpoint.
interpretation.baseline: The frozen Aug8–Sep4 eight-order/USD734.99 baseline stays separate; no combined28-day count or growth percentage.
interpretation.next_action: At normal native access, reconcile fulfillment and actual provider costs for these same two still-unfulfilled baskets before using either to qualify profitable paid expansion.
interpretation.authority: Read-only checkpoint; no campaign, budget, billing, tracking, listing, publication, account or paid-authority changes.

privacy.persisted: Only aggregate counts/money/status/country/day and public catalog product/variant identifiers. No customer, order, transaction, address, contact, raw landing URL, query parameter or tracking identifiers.
privacy.in_memory_only: Order IDs used to deduplicate the single current page; exact creation timestamps used only for the saved-basket comparison. No raw connector response saved.
privacy.clarification: shippingAddress selected countryCodeV2 only; no names or street/contact fields. No financial transaction/payment-detail query.

execution.docs_helper: Bundled search_docs failed once with 'fetch failed'; no retry. Supported connector schema and documentation search succeeded. This was not a Shopify account permission failure.
